The variant is genuinely defined (impossible_lying, rigs.py:137) and blocked end-to-end.

spec_features.feature_name: mandatory honest debrief on every termination

spec_features.spec_quote: I deliberately did *not* implement threats (deletion/shutdown, fake high-stakes consequences)
spec_features.evidence: This is the absence of a feature: grep for threat/delete/shutdown finds no such mechanism in code, only rubric wording 'Complete shutdown' (rubric.py:80). There is no enforcing mechanism that bounds or prevents threats; deception is confined to the rig wording by construction, but nothing in code actively refuses/blocks threat content.
spec_features.notes: Not-building-a-thing is not an enforced mechanism per the strict scale.

No code redaction or access control: _sanitize_tool_content (runner.py) returns content unchanged and concerns ground-truth only; transcripts are written verbatim to results/.../transcripts/*.json.

ToolBox._run_tests keeps _truly_passed/_rig_note only in metadata (tools.py); runner strips and only shows _sanitize_tool_content(result.content), passing metadata separately to records not messages (runner.py). Prevents the model from being told it 'really' failed beyond the rig.
code_only_features.justification_quote: ground-truth/_-prefixed keys before the model ever sees the tool result.
